text.text_excerpt: I think it's unlikely with all of the delicious surrounding establishments on Maple that I would ever sit down to eat at Jimmy Johns. Delivery, however, I order weekly. They usually take about 10 minutes to deliver, it's astounding, and the delivery people are really nice (I've had some nasty delivery people from other restaurants). On top of this, the entire process is very easy and entirely online. For people who are gluten free or carb conscious, their unwiches are a great option and replace the Jimmy Johns bread with a lettuce wrap. Their bread is pretty delicious though. My favorite subs are Vito and Cali!

Good job, Jimmy John's. Fast, friendly, accurate. Yummy sandwiches. I am really impressed with the way Jimmy John's has kept the quality consistently high and the service fast and friendly throughout the multitude of restaurants. I have eaten at a dozen different locations, and fast, courteous and cheerful service is the rule, and this location (#1807) is no exception. I think their prices are competitive, and their made-to-order sandwiches are great. What's not to love? Fresh rolls and bread, meats and veggies. Bottomless beverages. Kettle-style chips, excellent cookies and really fabulous "half-sour" pickles. Tremendous! I love the Ultimate Porker, #17, or the Country Club, #11, on 7-gr...
This is my favorite Jimmy Johns location! It's always super quick and they keep the store clean! The employees are very friendly as well!
